en.text: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 约沙法与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。 （王下8·17—24）

zhTraditional.text: 約沙法與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子約蘭接續他作王。 （王下8‧17－24）

en.text: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 约兰有几个兄弟，就是约沙法的儿子亚撒利雅、耶歇、撒迦利雅、亚撒利雅、米迦勒、示法提雅。这都是犹大王约沙法的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 約蘭有幾個兄弟，就是約沙法的兒子亞撒利雅、耶歇、撒迦利雅、亞撒利雅、米迦勒、示法提雅。這都是猶大王約沙法的兒子。

en.text: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的父亲将许多金银、财宝，和犹大地的坚固城赐给他们；但将国赐给约兰，因为他是长子。

zhTraditional.text: 他們的父親將許多金銀、財寶，和猶大地的堅固城賜給他們；但將國賜給約蘭，因為他是長子。

en.text: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 约兰兴起坐他父的位，奋勇自强，就用刀杀了他的众兄弟和以色列的几个首领。

zhTraditional.text: 約蘭興起坐他父的位，奮勇自強，就用刀殺了他的眾兄弟和以色列的幾個首領。

en.text: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。

zhTraditional.text: 約蘭登基的時候年三十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王八年。

en.text: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

zhSimplified.text: 他行以色列诸王的道，与亚哈家一样；因他娶了亚哈的女儿为妻，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

zhTraditional.text: 他行以色列諸王的道，與亞哈家一樣；因他娶了亞哈的女兒為妻，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事。

en.text: However the LORD would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华却因自己与大卫所立的约，不肯灭大卫的家，照他所应许的，永远赐灯光与大卫和他的子孙。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華卻因自己與大衛所立的約，不肯滅大衛的家，照他所應許的，永遠賜燈光與大衛和他的子孫。

en.text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。

zhTraditional.text: 約蘭年間，以東人背叛猶大，脫離他的權下，自己立王。

en.text: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

zhSimplified.text: 约兰就率领军长和所有的战车，夜间起来，攻击围困他的以东人和车兵长。

zhTraditional.text: 約蘭就率領軍長和所有的戰車，夜間起來，攻擊圍困他的以東人和車兵長。

en.text: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 这样，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，直到今日。那时，立拿人也背叛了，因为约兰离弃耶和华—他列祖的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，以東人背叛猶大，脫離他的權下，直到今日。那時，立拿人也背叛了，因為約蘭離棄耶和華－他列祖的上帝。

en.text: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.

zhSimplified.text: 他又在犹大诸山建筑邱坛，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，诱惑犹大人。

zhTraditional.text: 他又在猶大諸山建築邱壇，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，誘惑猶大人。

en.text: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “the LORD, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

zhSimplified.text: 先知以利亚达信与约兰说：「耶和华—你祖大卫的 神如此说：『因为你不行你父约沙法和犹大王亚撒的道，

zhTraditional.text: 先知以利亞達信與約蘭說：「耶和華－你祖大衛的上帝如此說：『因為你不行你父約沙法和猶大王亞撒的道，

en.text: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,

zhSimplified.text: 乃行以色列诸王的道，使犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，像亚哈家一样，又杀了你父家比你好的诸兄弟。

zhTraditional.text: 乃行以色列諸王的道，使猶大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，像亞哈家一樣，又殺了你父家比你好的諸兄弟。

en.text: behold, the LORD will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

zhSimplified.text: 故此，耶和华降大灾与你的百姓和你的妻子、儿女，并你一切所有的。

zhTraditional.text: 故此，耶和華降大災與你的百姓和你的妻子、兒女，並你一切所有的。

en.text: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”

zhSimplified.text: 你的肠子必患病，日加沉重，以致你的肠子坠落下来。』」

zhTraditional.text: 你的腸子必患病，日加沉重，以致你的腸子墜落下來。』」

en.text: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

zhSimplified.text: 以后，耶和华激动非利士人和靠近古实的阿拉伯人来攻击约兰。

zhTraditional.text: 以後，耶和華激動非利士人和靠近古實的阿拉伯人來攻擊約蘭。

en.text: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

zhSimplified.text: 他们上来攻击犹大，侵入境内，掳掠了王宫里所有的财货和他的妻子、儿女，除了他小儿子约哈斯之外，没有留下一个儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 他們上來攻擊猶大，侵入境內，擄掠了王宮裏所有的財貨和他的妻子、兒女，除了他小兒子約哈斯之外，沒有留下一個兒子。

en.text: After all this the LORD struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

zhSimplified.text: 这些事以后，耶和华使约兰的肠子患不能医治的病。

zhTraditional.text: 這些事以後，耶和華使約蘭的腸子患不能醫治的病。

en.text: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 他患此病缠绵日久，过了二年，肠子坠落下来，病重而死。他的民没有为他烧什么物件，像从前为他列祖所烧的一样。

zhTraditional.text: 他患此病纏綿日久，過了二年，腸子墜落下來，病重而死。他的民沒有為他燒甚麼物件，像從前為他列祖所燒的一樣。

en.text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

zhSimplified.text: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。他去世无人思慕，众人葬他在大卫城，只是不在列王的坟墓里。

zhTraditional.text: 約蘭登基的時候年三十二歲，在耶路撒冷作王八年。他去世無人思慕，眾人葬他在大衛城，只是不在列王的墳墓裏。
